source.optionsSnapshot: Dags schema as fetched 2026-10-28 (live schema fetch timed out on 2026-11-13; options added since then are missing)
source.countsMethod: sampled 406 of ~1,990 entries (300 via SQL in Notion's internal order, ~mid-2024 to Jan 2025 plus a few 2023; 100 most-recently-modified via the Mobile view, Sep-Nov 2026; 6 from the Oct-28 survey). Uses and lastUsed are sample-only and undercount; null lastUsed = not seen in sample.

threads.name: @CANI
threads.definition: My daily CANI check-in: what I did today, what worked, what to improve tomorrow. Pull it for weekly reviews and to spot streaks and slumps.

threads.name: @Emotion Control
threads.definition: Moments I caught a strong emotion and how I handled or reframed it. My log for mastering my state.

threads.name: @Weekly Reflection
threads.definition: My Sunday look back at the week: wins, lows, lessons, and what to change next week.

threads.name: @Patterns
threads.definition: Recurring patterns I notice in myself or others. Study these together to find root causes.

threads.name: @Success Bag
threads.definition: Proof of my wins: deals closed, breakthroughs, praise. Pull it when I doubt myself or need fuel.

threads.name: @Recipes
threads.definition: My personal recipes and protocols: step-by-step techniques that reliably get me into a state or a result.

threads.name: @Sales Mindset
threads.definition: Raw sales-mindset thoughts I capture, and how I resolve them. The thread I review to fix my inner game in sales.

threads.name: @Goal Updates
threads.definition: Dated progress reports on a specific goal (money, sales mastery, launches). Pull these to track one result over time.

threads.name: @The Conqueror
threads.definition: My Conqueror identity: moments and notes on stepping into the fighter, winner version of me.

threads.name: @Monthly Reflection
threads.definition: End-of-month review: the theme of the month, what moved, and what I carry into the next one.

threads.name: @Coaching
threads.definition: How I coach and help others change: frameworks, conversations, lessons as a coach.

threads.name: @Excuse Letter
threads.definition: My excuse letters: writing out the excuses I am making, then answering them.

threads.name: @Fashtag
threads.definition: Notes from my Fashtag / fashion-tech startup: hiring, team, product. (Past project; keep for its history.)

threads.name: @Pattern Break
threads.definition: Times I broke a negative loop on purpose, and the technique that worked.

threads.name: @Sales Training
threads.definition: Sales skill material I am building: objection handling, scripts, call processes. My playbook to study and drill.

threads.name: @Open Questions
threads.definition: Open questions I am chewing on and want to answer later.

threads.name: @Hour of Power
threads.definition: My morning priming session: what I primed, visualised and committed to.

threads.name: @Sales Coaching
threads.definition: Coaching sessions and strategy around my sales work (with Lukas and others). Pull to prepare the next session.

threads.name: @Metaphors
threads.definition: Metaphors and analogies I collect to explain ideas and persuade.

threads.name: @Annual Reflection
threads.definition: Year-end review: the story of my year and what I set for the next.

threads.name: @Limiting Beliefs
threads.definition: Limiting beliefs I have spotted, plus the new belief I am replacing each one with.

threads.name: @Unsent Messages
threads.definition: Messages I wrote to someone but did not send. Processing what I really want to say.

threads.name: @Quarterly Reflection
threads.definition: Quarter review against my bigger goals: direction check and course corrections.

threads.name: @Discovering Me
threads.definition: Self-discovery: who I am, my traits, strengths and drives.

threads.name: @Philosophy
threads.definition: My philosophy and life principles: worldview pieces I want to refine over time.

threads.name: @What Would A Leader Do
threads.definition: Situations where I ask what a real leader would do. Leadership decisions to study.

threads.name: @Questions For Successful People
threads.definition: Questions I want to ask successful people, and their answers.

threads.name: @Quotes
threads.definition: Quotes worth keeping and re-reading.

threads.name: @Post
threads.definition: Drafts and ideas for posts I want to publish.

threads.name: @Business
threads.definition: Business ideas and business thinking to come back to.

threads.name: @Anki
threads.definition: Material to turn into flashcards and memorise.
